summary: Ivanhoe Electric filed an 8-K reporting an amended and restated shareholders agreement with Maaden for their 50/50 Saudi joint venture. The amendment extends the exploration term to 2033, allows the joint venture to hold licenses directly, and adjusts governance provisions. No merger, acquisition, or other special-situation event occurred; this is a routine contractual update between existing partners. No financial terms, premiums, or strategic changes are involved.
